bio.text: Chris Aniskovich has represented Connecticut's 35th House District since January 2023 and is the Republican candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
He was born in Branford and lives in Clinton, and graduated from Notre Dame High School in 1983 and earned a business administration degree from Merrimack College in 1987.
He worked as a wholesale manager for Fairfield Financial Mortgage and owned Security Financial Mortgage Corp.
He chaired the Clinton Town Council and served on the Clinton Planning and Zoning Commission and Board of Assessment Appeals.
